Wizard's power spike occurs at the level where spell tiers unlock.

GMs: At level 3, when Wizards unlock second-tier spells, ensure players prioritize utility spells over raw damage for survival.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Green-Flame Blade has a range of 5 feet and affects two targets.

DMs: Remind them the secondary target for Green-Flame Blade must be within 5 feet of the primary target, not the caster.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Use Kobold Avatar as an encounter seed with clear stakes and one hard decision about save resources now or spend big to control tempo.

Judges: When the Kobold Avatar's nightmare of dead generations triggers, remind them to save their best spells for after it hits.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Passwall creates a temporary tunnel for 5 rounds in a barrier you touch.

GMs: Force them to use Passwall's 5-round window to bypass obstacles, not just shuffle around the grid.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Awakened Tree has a Strength score of 19 and a Slam attack that deals 3d6 + 4 bludgeoning damage.

DMs: Place the Awakened Tree in dense forest terrain to mitigate its 20-foot speed and maximize its 3d6 + 4 Slam attack.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Boots of Mist-Stepping allow movement through 30 feet of air as mist, once per day.

Judges: Have them use the Boots of Mist-Stepping to bypass obstacles pre-combat, avoiding the Fort DC 11 curse mid-battle.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Morale checks trigger at half losses or when a strong ally falls.

GMs: Roll a DC 15 Wisdom check for morale at half losses or a fallen ally; skip it and expect chaos.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Path of Wild Magic triggers random magical effects while raging.

DMs: Signal the Path of Wild Magic pivot by declaring your action economy shift from Magic Awareness to rage-induced chaos.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Mighty Deeds of Arms require no saving throw or opposed roll.

Judges: Enforce that Mighty Deeds need no saving throw; just a hit and a Deed die of 3 or more.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Kraken is perfect for a playful encounter that can still punish bad habits.

GMs: Make them roll a DEX save DC 15 each round or watch their ship capsize in the Kraken's storm.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Hiding requires the DM to determine when circumstances allow it.

DMs: Clarify that hiding requires both cover and a successful Stealth check, not just a whim or wish.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Fly drops you mid-air if the spell ends unexpectedly.

Judges: Remind them Fly's spell check determines duration - cast it low to the ground unless they enjoy plummeting.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70
